Order the sides of the triangle $△ABC$ above from the shortest to the longest.
question.worked_solution:
First, let's find the missing angle $A.$ Since the interior angles of a triangle sum to ${180}^{∘},$ we have

$$
\begin{aligned}m∠A+m∠B+m∠C & ={180}^{∘} \\ m∠A+{90}^{∘}+{46}^{∘} & ={180}^{∘} \\ m∠A & ={180}^{∘}-{136}^{∘} \\ m∠A & ={44}^{∘}.\end{aligned}
$$

Since $∠B$ is the largest angle, its opposite side $\overset{―}{AC}$ must be the longest side of the triangle. 

Since $∠A$ is the smallest angle, its opposite side $\overset{―}{BC}$ is the shortest side of the triangle.

So, we have

$$
BC<AB<AC
$$

and therefore, the required order is

$$
\overset{―}{BC},\overset{―}{AB},\overset{―}{AC}.
$$
